headline: South Africa’s Zeitz MOCAA Names Director to Replace Koyo Kouoh
context: Elvira Dyangani Ose, who directed Barcelona’s contemporary art museum, will succeed Koyo Kouoh at Zeitz MOCAA after she died suddenly last year from cancer.

sources.name: The New York Times
